TradeComps: Trade Competitiveness & Investment Attractiveness in Sub-Saharan Africa

Author

Ludovic Njiosseu, MS Biostatistics

Published

May 19, 2026

Overview

This project analyzes trade competitiveness and foreign direct investment dynamics for 12 Sub-Saharan African economies across the EAC, ECOWAS, and SADC regional blocs, covering 2015–2023. It is motivated by the implementation of the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA) and the question of which economies are best positioned to benefit.

Data sources simulated from: World Bank WDI, ITC Trade Map, UNCTAD bilateral FDI statistics.

Module 1 — Data Construction

Code 
source("scripts/01_simulate_data.R")
Trade panel: 108 rows × 13 columns
Countries: 12 | Years: 2015–2023
Saved: data/trade_panel.csv
Code 
library(tidyverse)

The panel dataset covers 12 economies × 9 years (108 observations). Key variables: Revealed Comparative Advantage (RCA), export concentration (HHI), FDI inflows, regulatory environment, infrastructure index, trade openness, and AfCFTA readiness.

RCA Rankings

Code 
rca_latest <- read_csv("outputs/rca_ranking_latest.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
rca_latest %>%
  mutate(country = fct_reorder(country, rca)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = country, y = rca, fill = region)) +
  geom_col() + coord_flip() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(EAC = "#2980b9", ECOWAS = "#27ae60", SADC = "#e74c3c")) +
  labs(title = "Revealed Comparative Advantage — Latest Year",
       x = NULL, y = "RCA Index", fill = "Region",
       caption = "RCA > 1 indicates export comparative advantage") +
  theme_minimal()

Value Chain Quadrant Analysis

Code 
quadrant <- read_csv("outputs/quadrant_analysis.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
quadrant %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = hhi_export, y = rca, color = quadrant, label = country)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(size = 3, max.overlaps = 15) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = median(quadrant$hhi_export), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = median(quadrant$rca),        linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  labs(title = "Value Chain Quadrant: RCA × Export Diversification",
       x = "Export Concentration (HHI)", y = "RCA Index", color = "Quadrant") +
  theme_minimal()

FDI Trends by Region

Code 
fdi_region <- read_csv("outputs/fdi_by_region.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
fdi_region %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = regional_fdi_bn, color = region, group = region)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) + geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(EAC = "#2980b9", ECOWAS = "#27ae60", SADC = "#e74c3c")) +
  labs(title = "FDI Inflows by Region (USD bn, 2015–2023)",
       x = NULL, y = "FDI (USD bn)", color = "Region") +
  theme_minimal()

The 2020 COVID shock is visible across all regions, with differential recovery trajectories.

FDI Determinants

Code 
fdi_det <- read_csv("outputs/fdi_determinants.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
knitr::kable(fdi_det, caption = "OLS Regression: Determinants of FDI Inflows (log)")
OLS Regression: Determinants of FDI Inflows (log)
variable coefficient std_error t_value p_value
(Intercept) -1.3288 0.7903 -1.681 0.0985
regulatory_env -0.4539 0.1932 -2.349 0.0225
infrastructure 0.2121 0.1781 1.191 0.2390
trade_openness 0.3969 0.6625 0.599 0.5516
afcfta_readiness 0.2657 0.1425 1.865 0.0676
rca 1.0773 0.3353 3.212 0.0022

Regulatory environment and infrastructure are the strongest predictors of FDI inflows, consistent with established FDI location theory. AfCFTA readiness has a positive but smaller coefficient, reflecting its recent implementation.

Reproducibility

install.packages(c("tidyverse", "ggrepel", "shiny", "bslib", "bsicons"))

source("scripts/01_simulate_data.R")
source("scripts/02_competitiveness_index.R")
source("scripts/03_fdi_analysis.R")
source("scripts/04_regional_policy.R")

shiny::runApp("shiny/")
quarto::quarto_render("tradecomps_report.qmd")

Limitations & Extensions

  • Data is simulated to approximate published WDI/UNCTAD patterns; actual analysis would use API-pulled panel data.
  • The RCA index is simplified — production analysis would compute bilateral RCA across product-level HS codes.
  • Panel regression with country and year fixed effects would better isolate causal FDI determinants.
  • Value chain depth (processing stage, GVC participation) is not modeled; this is the key gap for AfCFTA sector analysis.
